name: requeue
description: Router: revive a parked card and retire its exec run.

name: ready
description: Open items whose deps are done, with D-ids + STALE flag (stale last); mine=your items, agent=no operator steps. Run show before work.

name: show
description: ALWAYS read before work, never start from a title: desc, done, deps/dependents + why, evidence, D-ids, last activity, merged commits, open lanes, STALE. brief=true short.

name: claim
description: Claim a ready item after show; refuses merged/superseded/premise-outdated items; force_stale=<reason> overrides (audited).

name: delegate
description: Hand a claimed item to a worker principal.

name: heartbeat
description: Extend a lease at the given epoch.

name: release
description: Return a claimed item to open.

name: evidence
description: Attach evidence {kind, ref} to a claimed item.

name: submit
description: Submit claimed work for review.

name: verdict
description: Reviewer passes or requests changes.

name: waive_second_family
description: Router: waive the second-family rule (verified decision).

name: close_merged
description: Router: close one merged in_review item on a head-bound GO decision.

name: withdraw_review
description: Router: take a decision-closable item out of review (decision names it in Closes:).

name: reopen
description: Router: take an in_review item back to its claimant at epoch+1 (reason + recorded decision; never closes).

name: set_kind
description: Router: turn an open lane into a question or operator_task (waits on the operator).

name: close_on_decision
description: Router: close a tier-none item on a verified decision + hashed batch file.

name: answer
description: Router: answer a question/decision item (verified decision names it in Closes:) and close it.

name: set_legacy_state
description: Router: move an open legacy item to claimed/in_review.

name: apply_ops
description: Router: apply a list of BATCH.md ops atomically (one transaction).

name: cancel
description: Cancel an active item.

name: priority
description: Set router-owned priority.

name: blocked
description: Active items with unmet dependencies.

name: waves
description: Layered schedule of non-terminal items.

name: critical_path
description: Longest remaining path by estimate.

name: percent
description: Percent complete.

name: needs_you
description: Items waiting on the operator (operator flag or question/decision/operator_task), most-blocking first.

name: answers
description: Answered question/decision items, newest first, with superseded_by when corrected.

name: audit_meta
description: Router/l1: items missing description/estimate/done criteria/owner, plus claims quiet for stale_days days.

name: alerts
description: Leases, overdue reviews, findings, refusals.

name: digest
description: Per-project counts and recent done (router).

name: whoami
description: The authenticated principal.

name: create
description: Create items: l1 in own project only, router anywhere.

name: edit
description: Edit an open item: l1 own project only, router anywhere; locked once done/cancelled.

name: mint_run_token
description: Router/l1: mint a run-bound token (writer|reviewer) for a claimed/in_review item; shown once.

name: record_run
description: Spawner: record which models ran on a claimed item.

name: fleet_msg_send
description: Bus: signed write {to, text}; queued in the spool if the peer is down.

name: fleet_msg_read
description: Bus: message rows for this host; since is a sequence or a timestamp.
